web_blocks.html: Intuitive Surgical (NASDAQ: ISRG) leads global soft-tissue robotic surgery [3, 4]. As of September 30, 2026, it runs 12,094 da Vinci systems (+12% YoY) and 1,152 Ion endoluminal systems (+21% YoY) [3, 4]. From FY2016 to FY2025, revenue grew at a 15.7% CAGR from $2.70 billion to $10.06 billion [1]. TTM sales hit $11.58 billion (+20.45% YoY) with a 32.25% operating margin, 18.50% ROIC, and zero debt ($6.80 billion cash and investments at Q3 2026) [1, 3, 22]. Roughly 84% of sales are recurring from single-use tools, accessories, service contracts, and leases [4].

ISRG shares fell 26.54% from their $603.88 52-week high. Three headwinds drove the drop: slower U.S. bariatric volume from GLP-1 drugs and expiring ACA subsidies, 65–120 bps of tariff pressure, and 5.10% 10-year Treasury yields [13, 14, 22, 26]. At $443.59, ISRG trades at 35.52x Forward P/E. While our 10W/30W screen shows an 11.15% VCP squeeze, the primary ledger classifies ISRG as Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) (declining 200D SMA $429.38, 50D < 200D, 7 distribution days, Correction regime) [23]. Our Reverse DCF anchored on audited FY2025 FCF ($2,491.2M) prices in 16.89%–18.35% 10-year FCF CAGR at 8.5%–9.0% WACC (vs. 12.15% on implied TTM FCF of $3,598.0M). Under a 28.0x Forward P/E stress test ($370.72–$395.08), chasing $443.59 lacks margin of safety. We assign WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT for new capital (CORE_ALPHA, TIER_3, Support Zone $418.34–$431.08, Base Target $515.00, PWV $491.25, Hard Stop $401.77, 2.86:1 support asymmetry). Existing portfolio status is NOT_HELD (0 shares to sell).

A 100-share common-stock lot costs $44,359. Once support holds or $464.22 breaks out, our options desk flags the 2027-09-17 $400 LEAPS Call (306 DTE, 0.71 Delta) near $93.00 ($9,300.00 max risk, $493.00 breakeven) under an IV_FAIR regime [27]. Note that thin open interest (7 contracts) and an $8.00 spread create ~4%+ slippage risk, and the $9,300.00 debit exceeds our $7,434.75 consolidated cash ($88,684.68 net worth), requiring limit orders and fresh cash or a trim. On opportunity cost, ISRG ranks behind Microsoft (MSFT, 1.90:1 R:R) at CMP until it pulls back into support, while outranking Stryker (SYK, 1.35:1 CMP R:R) on growth and ROIC.

book_subsections.title: The Case for Intuitive Surgical in Three Minutes
paragraphs: Intuitive Surgical is one of the rarest assets in public equities: an unlevered clinical monopoly whose installed base generates an 84 percent recurring revenue stream every time a surgeon steps up to the console. As of September 30, 2026, more than 12,094 da Vinci systems and 1,152 Ion lung-biopsy systems sit inside operating rooms around the world. Over the past decade, revenue compounded nearly fourfold from $2.70 billion to $10.06 billion in FY2025, reaching $11.58 billion on a trailing twelve-month basis with a 32.25 percent operating margin, 18.50 percent return on invested capital, and $6.80 billion of cash against zero debt.

Yet over the past year, the stock fell more than 26 percent from its $603.88 peak as U.S. procedure growth cooled toward 10 percent under GLP-1 bariatric headwinds, tariffs trimmed gross margins by 65 to 120 basis points, and 10-year Treasury yields reached 5.10 percent. At $443.59, the forward multiple has compressed to 35.52 times—near the bottom quartile of its five-year range. Anchored on audited FY2025 free cash flow ($2,491.2 million), our Reverse DCF still requires 16.89% to 18.35% ten-year compounding at an 8.5% to 9.0% WACC (versus 12.15% on implied TTM FCF of $3,598.0 million). In addition, a 28.0x Forward P/E stress test yields $370.72 to $395.08, breaching our $401.77 stop and showing why chasing $443.59 lacks margin of safety.

Technically, while the 10-week EMA ($424.71) and 30-week SMA ($409.00) screen flags a short-term VCP squeeze, our primary ledger places ISRG in Stage 3 (Topping / Pullback) due to a declining 200-day SMA ($429.38), 50-day SMA below 200-day SMA, and seven distribution days in 25 sessions. Our verdict is clear and disciplined. For new capital, Intuitive Surgical earns WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (CORE_ALPHA, TIER_3) with a $418.34 to $431.08 entry zone, $515.00 Base Target, $590.00 Bull Target, $345.00 Bear Target, and a $401.77 hard stop—delivering 2.86-to-1 asymmetry at support. For our existing portfolio, it is NOT_HELD with zero shares to sell.

book_subsections.title: What Could Break the Thesis—and How We Know Early
paragraphs: Every institutional thesis requires clear falsification criteria so we never confuse a structural deterioration with a temporary dip. Three watchpoints govern our PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI rating. First, watch U.S. da Vinci procedure growth: it moderated to roughly 10 percent in Q3 2026 under GLP-1 and ACA headwinds. A slip below 9 percent in Q4 2026 or FY2027 guidance risks compression toward our $345.00 Bear Case. Second, watch gross margins and the 3%–5% benign-procedure instrument pricing actions: tariffs already cost 65 to 120 bps, so non-GAAP gross margins below 67% would challenge our Base Case. Third, respect the tape: a weekly close below $401.77 invalidates structural support and cancels pending buy orders.

Taken together, Intuitive Surgical is a premier 84 percent recurring monopoly whose valuation reset is partially complete, but Stage 3 ledger signals and 28x multiple-compression risk argue for patience. Waiting for the $418.34 to $431.08 support zone—or a confirmed volume breakout above $464.22—protects capital and restores 2.86-to-1 asymmetry.
